What Is The Elements @ Ampang? Overview and Core Identity
The Elements @ Ampang is a freehold serviced residence in Ampang Hilir, Kuala Lumpur, developed by Elite Forward Sdn Bhd, a joint venture between Land & General Berhad and Mayland Group. The project was completed in 2013 to 2014 and is positioned in the Ampang Embassy Row corridor, approximately 3 to 4 km from KLCC.

1,040 units are distributed across two 41-storey towers with 12 units per floor and 4 lifts per tower. Eleven layout types are offered from studio (640 sq ft) to 3+1-bedroom (1,570 sq ft). Units were delivered with kitchen cabinets with hob and hood, air-conditioning, hot and cold water system, and fully fitted bathrooms. Facilities floors are at Levels 5 and 42, with the Level 42 rooftop providing a sky garden and viewing deck with unobstructed KL skyline views toward the Petronas Twin Towers and Melawati Hills.

Where Is The Elements @ Ampang Located? Location and Public Transport
The Elements @ Ampang is located off Jalan Ampang, in Ampang Hilir, within the Embassy Row corridor of Kuala Lumpur. The development is surrounded by embassies, international schools, and expatriate-oriented amenities, close to Great Eastern Mall and Gleneagles Hospital.

Dato' Keramat LRT (Kelana Jaya Line KJ6) and Jelatek LRT (KJ5) are the nearest rail stations. A free daily shuttle bus service connects residents to KLCC, Jalan Ampang commercial strip, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, and Bukit Bintang, providing a managed commuting alternative to driving.

What Roads Serve The Elements @ Ampang? Road Access and Traffic Reality
The Elements @ Ampang is accessible via the Ampang-Kuala Lumpur Elevated Highway (AKLEH), Jalan Ampang, Jalan Tun Razak, Duta-Ulu Kelang Expressway (DUKE), MRR2, and SMART Tunnel. These roads and highways connect the Ampang Hilir corridor toward KLCC, the city centre, and surrounding areas.

Jalan Ampang is one of KL's more congested arterial roads, particularly during weekday peak hours toward the city centre and Bukit Bintang. The AKLEH provides an elevated bypass for residents heading toward Cheras, MRR2, and the eastern Klang Valley.

What Are the Unit Sizes at The Elements @ Ampang? Unit Layouts and Parking
The Elements @ Ampang offers 11 layout types from studio to 3+1-bedroom configurations.

All units were delivered with fitted kitchen, air-conditioning, and bathroom fittings. Car parking is provided within the development.

What Facilities Does The Elements @ Ampang Have?
Facilities at The Elements are located across two dedicated floors — Level 5 and Level 42. They include an infinity pool, wading pool, jacuzzi, sauna, sky garden, rooftop viewing deck, private garden lounge, green pavilions, cabanas, water features, gymnasium, children's playground, jogging track, squash court, tennis court, business centre, club house, cafeteria, minimart, nursery, salon, and laundrette.
